name: devx-multichain-balances

tools.name: basic_balance
tools.description: Free: native coin + USDC (USDT on Tron) balance of one address on one chain (base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, avalanche, bsc, solana, tron). Address: EVM 0x, Solana base58 or Tron T...

address.description: EVM 0x, Solana base58 or Tron T... address

chain.description: default: base for 0x, solana or tron otherwise

tools.name: multichain_balances
tools.description: Paid, 0.002 USDC (x402 on Base, from the wallet in X402_PRIVATE_KEY): native + USDC/USDT/DAI/EURC/bridged USDC/WETH/WBTC on 7 EVM chains, SOL + USDC/USDT on Solana, TRX + USDT on Tron, plus custom tokens, for up to 3 addresses (one per family) in one call, with block numbers and a stablecoin total. Without a key it returns the quote and does not pay.

addresses.description: EVM 0x, Solana and/or Tron addresses (max one each)

chains.description: default: every chain matching the addresses

tokens.description: custom tokens as chain:address, e.g. base:0x...

tools.name: multichain_balances_info
tools.description: Price, URL and payment details of the paid hosted call. Does not pay.

instructions: Wallet balances on 7 EVM chains, Solana and Tron via the hosted DevX API. basic_balance is free. multichain_balances costs 0.002 USDC per call via x402 on Base and pays only if X402_PRIVATE_KEY is set in this server's environment (cap 0.01 USDC); otherwise it returns the price quote.
